profiles.subject: An adult with the torso and waist visible; an apron can be worn naturally over simple work clothes. The hands must be available for a plausible light task.
profiles.setting: A cafe service counter, home kitchen, bakery prep area, or craft workshop with visible work surfaces and relevant objects. Show a relaxed, plausible activity such as arranging cups, preparing ingredients, or working at a bench.
profiles.reject: Decorative gates, arbitrary doorways, bedrooms, golf courses, sports props, and a person merely posing with hands hidden in apron pockets and no work context.
profiles.details: The apron itself: bib shape, neck strap, waist ties, front pockets, fabric color and embroidery. The white shirt underneath is not the product.
profiles.branding: Only if the product shows a logo: replace every real brand name, logo, wordmark, store mark and label from the product reference and source photos with one small fictional brand. Keep the product's own artwork, print, text design and colors; only the brand identity changes. Never add GOLF or unrelated sports branding.
